name: Kokoda Memorial Track

facts.claim: Officially the Kokoda Track Memorial Walk, the steep 1000 Steps climb from Ferntree Gully Picnic Area in Dandenong Ranges National Park
Commemorates Australian Second World War veterans of the Kokoda Track Campaign
Described as probably Melbourne's most popular bushwalk
